reuse.why: Every ranged-amount site now calls the existing exported getScheduledAmount with its raw value, relying on the helper's own missing/number/range dispatch.

duplication.why: All five midpoint copies and their null/number dispatch are removed; the rule exists once.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, already the shared home used by server and client.

scope.why: Only the rule, its call sites, their comments and a focused test.

maintainability.why: Changing the expected amount of a ranged schedule is now a single edit in one helper all paths use.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No site keeps its own amount computation.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, called by schedule-template, forecast-schedules, schedules/app.ts (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule) and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions.
